column1: # System libraries that the published binaries may load, and that a build
# script may name (platform "build-script"), per D4 (plan section 6, third and
# fourth layers): the operating-system and C runtime libraries that the Rust
# standard library itself links (R15). Columns: platform, library;
# tab-separated. A library ending in * matches by prefix; names compare
# Linux: measured on 2026-11-22 by CI on ubuntu-26.04, with readelf --dynamic.
# glibc, its loader, and GCC's unwinder, which the standard library uses.
# Windows: measured on 2026-11-22 by CI on windows-2025. Windows itself, the
# Universal C runtime (part of Windows since Windows 10), and the Visual C++
# runtime, which is not part of Windows (GS.4 on 2026-11-22, R15).
